newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese opposition demands economic changes.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese opposition demands economic changes.

text.p: Following are demands for economic changes made by critics of Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri at a mass meeting on Friday night which also called for reinforcement of public freedoms:
1. Reconsider the priorities of reconstruction and strike
a balance between the needs of the country and its
ability to carry the burden of those needs.
2. Activate the economy by giving more attention and
priority to industry, agriculture and tourism.
